headline: Sugarslime
title: Sugarslime | Downpour Ice Evolution | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Sugarslime is a stage three Ice Aniimo that evolves from Sugarfish at level sixty two with one Freeze Stone. Enthusiastic Feeding throws Sweet Blobs at power forty eight. Its ultimate Sugary Downpour has power one hundred and a twenty second cooldown. Homeland work is Ice, Leisure and Hauling at level three. It is a friendly late game Ice option. Would you choose Sugarslime? Comment below!
description: Sugarslime guide: stage 3 Ice Aniimo from Sugarfish (Lv. 62, Freeze Stone). Enthusiastic Feeding, the Sugary Downpour ultimate (power 100) and level 3 Ice, Leisure and Hauling Homeland work. Checked on aniimo.gg and metabot.gg in November 2026.
joke: Sugarslime shares its slime with everyone, even when nobody asked.
